facts.fact: Africa24 reports Central African customs officers processing cargo on the computer through Sydonia World at M'poko airport and the Bangui dry port, with declarations handled in real time per the dry-port head.

Africa24 lists e-Tax among the operational financial applications, serving taxpayers' remote filing (télédéclaration), with the director general of taxes describing taxpayers making declarations through digitalisation.

systems.owner: Ministere des Finances et du Budget
